question: How might ICT enhance the openness of e-land records?

options.text: Enabling quick search and retrieval of land records
Reducing the need for land surveys and assessments
Facilitating manual record updates and amendments
Enforcing strict regulations on land transactions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Enabling quick search and retrieval of land records**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enabling quick search and retrieval of land records** is one of the primary ways ICT can enhance the openness of e-land records.
 
• ICT facilitates the digitization and online availability of land records, making it easier for stakeholders to access information efficiently.
 
• With digital records, transparency is increased as the data is less prone to tampering and unauthorized alterations.
 
• ICT systems can provide real-time updates and tracking of land records, reducing delays and increasing the reliability of information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ICT stands for **Information and Communication Technology**, which encompasses various digital tools and systems used to manage, process, and share information.
 
• Implementation of ICT in land records management can significantly reduce administrative costs and human errors.
 
• By improving access to land records, ICT can help in resolving disputes and enhancing land tenure security.
 
• ICT-driven platforms often include features like GIS mapping, which provides visual representation and spatial analysis of land data.
 
• Electronic land records can also facilitate better planning and development by providing accurate and up-to-date information to policymakers.
